title: Carnival Masks
text: A street party spills out of a side street. One of the dancers wears a mask that does not come off.

pass.text: You follow the dancer to a door with a symbol you know.

title: The Cable Car
text: The cable car to the top of the granite peak sways over the bay. From up here you can see the whole city, and the shadow in the water.

pass.text: You watch the shadow until you know where it is going.

fail.text: The car stops halfway, and swings in the wind for an hour.

title: A Temple in the Hills
text: Drums and singing come from a temple in the hills. The priestess sees the darkness on you and invites you in.

pass.text: The priestess cleanses you with smoke, song, and cold water.

fail.text: You are welcome to stay, but you do not understand the ceremony.

title: The Harbor Master
text: The harbor master keeps records of every ship, and of every ship that did not arrive.

pass.text: He hires you to look into a missing freighter, and pays in advance.

fail.text: He is too busy to talk.
